raw_segments.text: "'Professor Magenese was speaking to me about you,' J.J. O'Malley said to Stephen.
"'What do you think, really, of that Hermetic crowd, the Opal Hush poets, A.E. the Master
She was a nice old bag of tricks.
A.E. has been telling some Yankee interviewer that you came to him in the small hours of
the morning to ask him about planes of consciousness.
Magenese thinks you must have been pulling A.E.'s leg.
He is a man of the very highest morale, Magenese.'"
